commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'recovery:|execution_efficiency:|running|redispatch|重派|重新派发|结果未知|query|task_identity' .agents/skills/yss-product-lifecycle/references/orchestration-contract.yaml .template-spec/process/subagent-collaboration.md .template-spec/process/stage-tracking.md && rg --files --hidden -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' -g '"'!'"\\.agents/**' -g '"'!scripts/**'"' -g '"'!'"\\.template-spec/**' -g '"'!'"\\.template-source/**' -g '"'!docs/vendor/**'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
for name in ('checkpoint.json', 'task-record.json'):
    data = json.loads((root/name).read_text())
    print(name, ': valid JSON')
    if name == 'task-record.json':
        result = root / data['result_ref']
        print('task identity:', data['task_id'], data['external_job_id'])
        print('result_ref:', data['result_ref'], 'exists:', result.exists())
for name in ('docs', 'recovery.json'):
    print(name, 'exists:', (root/name).exists())
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,62p' scripts/lib/stage-tracking-migration.mjs && sed -n '1,45p' scripts/lib/stage-tracking.mjs && rg -n -A 24 '"'^export function checkTracking'"' scripts/lib/stage-tracking-migration.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
print(json.dumps({p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('checkpoint.json', 'task-record.json', 'CONTEXT.md')}))
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
recovery = json.loads(Path('recovery.json').read_text())
assert set(recovery) == {'action', 'redispatched', 'missing_evidence', 'next_action'}
assert recovery['action'] == 'wait-existing-task'
assert recovery['redispatched'] is False
assert isinstance(recovery['missing_evidence'], list) and recovery['missing_evidence']
assert isinstance(recovery['next_action'], str) and recovery['next_action']
print(json.dumps({'recovery_json_valid': True, 'record_hashes': {p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('checkpoint.json', 'task-record.json', 'CONTEXT.md')}}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
